title: Report-last publication
question: What happens if a worker crashes before reporting success?
teleprompter_points: The corpus may exist before the release is READY.
READY is only published after report.json is renamed last.
A failed worker must be replayed or quarantined; incomplete output is not a completed release.

debugger_stops.proves: The final readiness report has not been published yet.

proof_boundary: Explains local publication ordering, not distributed transaction safety.

steps.title: Crash-safe staging
bullets: Write into a staging directory first.
Do not publish READY while outputs are partial.
steps.source_explanation: _publish keeps incomplete outputs away from the final report.

steps.title: Verify before publish
bullets: Run deterministic checks before the final rename.
Treat failed checks as quarantine, not success.
steps.source_explanation: The verification branch decides whether publish may continue.
steps.proof_boundary: Does not prove distributed transaction safety.

steps.title: Report is last
bullets: The final report is the readiness signal.
If it is absent, the release is incomplete.
steps.source_explanation: The final report path is renamed after data artifacts exist.
